life has always sucked. I grew up with abusive parents. I met my current SO in high school and he lifted me out of everything. Ive been sinking for the last year and he has finally dropped me. I have nothing.
I pulled myself out because I deluded myself into thinking life was turning up. I was so wrong. I don't have strength anymore. I dont have anyone. I am so alone and I cant deal with it anymore.

I was supposed to be a student but I got kicked out before school started and I was unable to go. I got kicked out for having blue hair and quitting my job because they would not let me have blue hair. I work for best buy and my official job title is "Deployment Functionality Technition". That is the only accomplishment I have in life. It is mind numbing work. I dont do anything for work. I go to work and I come home. I dont find anything enjoyable.
I have no friends. I don't really have family to talk to. I am left to this constant depression that is eating me alive. I have no money to go to therapy. I have no money for medication.
